name: CAPMAS Egypt statistical releases and news

name: CAPMAS Egypt related official websites
description: 100 Egyptian official bodies with Arabic title, live URL, websiteTypeId classification and an English translation array - effectively a machine-readable directory of Egyptian government and public-sector web presences.

name: CAPMAS Egypt country reference list
description: 243 countries as used across CAPMAS trade and migration statistics: numeric id, Arabic name and countryTranslations with the English name and locale. The join key for Egyptian trade-partner data.

name: CAPMAS Egypt governorates
description: All 27 Egyptian governorates with id, Arabic name, English translation, administrative code and area in km2 - the geographic key for every CAPMAS subnational series.

name: CAPMAS Egypt regional offices
description: 37 CAPMAS regional and central offices with Arabic name, governorate, street address, phone number, e-mail, and latitude/longitude - a geolocated directory of Egyptian statistical-agency premises with contact details.

name: CAPMAS Egypt organisational sectors
description: The 8 internal sectors of CAPMAS (population statistics and census division, etc.) with Arabic title, HTML description of remit, English translation, and created/updated audit timestamps.

name: CAPMAS Egypt agency heads (historical roster)
description: Named individuals who have led CAPMAS: full name with rank, portrait image path, startYear/endYear of tenure, isCurrent flag and an English translation array. A person-level record set behind an Egyptian state institution.

name: CAPMAS Egypt institutional history
description: 11 dated milestones in the history of Egyptian official statistics with Arabic title, description, year and image, plus English translations.

name: CAPMAS Egypt data services and tools
description: 12 CAPMAS data products/tools with title, short description, full HTML 'about' text, target link, isInternal/isNew flags and departmentId - a map of what Egyptian statistical data is published and where.

name: CAPMAS Egypt headline indicators
description: Egypt's current headline statistics as published by CAPMAS: indicator title (e.g. annual unemployment rate), unit, studyPeriod, numeric value and the linked publicationIndicatorId. Live macro figures, not a catalogue.

name: CAPMAS Egypt statistical subject tree
description: 5 top-level statistical domains each with a nested subSubjects array (13 under economic statistics alone), hasData flags and English translations - the taxonomy needed to address CAPMAS data queries.

name: CAPMAS Egypt media library
description: CAPMAS video items with title, description, publishing date, media URL and category id; envelope also carries a page object with totalCount.

name: ANSD Senegal annual activity reports (JSON:API)

name: ANSD Senegal census reports (JSON:API)
description: Senegalese population census report nodes (RGP76 onwards) with uuid, title, description and attached census volumes.

name: ANSD Senegal methodological resources (JSON:API)
description: ANSD methodological guides (e.g. 'Guide Pratique de Projections Demographiques') with uuid, title, body and attached documents.

name: ANSD Senegal events (JSON:API)
description: ANSD event nodes (e.g. 'Lancement cartographie pilote du RGPH-5') with uuid, title, event dates and body - useful for tracking the Senegalese census operation calendar.

name: ANSD Senegal recruitment competitions (JSON:API)
description: Public recruitment/competition notices issued by ANSD (e.g. 'Avis de concours pour le recrutement d'eleves Ingenieurs') with uuid, title, body and deadline dates.

name: ANSD Senegal administrative procedures (JSON:API)

name: BRVM regional stock exchange announcements

name: INSD Burkina Faso statistics institute feed
description: Burkina Faso national statistics institute Drupal feed: publications, and notably named recruitment result lists by province ('LISTE DES CANDIDATS ADMIS POUR LE COMPTE DU ZIRO/SANGUIE'), each with title, link, description and pubDate.

name: INS Cameroun statistics institute feed
description: Cameroon national statistics institute feed with report and survey announcements (e.g. 'CAMEROON JOINT MONITORING REPORT/RAPPORT DE SUIVI CONJOINT DU CAMEROUN') carrying title, link, dc:creator, pubDate and full content:encoded body.

name: OHADA organisation announcements
description: Official feed of OHADA, the 17-state African business-law harmonisation organisation whose Uniform Acts govern company law, security interests and insolvency across francophone Africa. Items carry title (e.g. 'L'Echo de l'OHADA N°001 avril-juin 2026'), link, author, pubDate and full content.

name: HCP Morocco - Haut-Commissariat au Plan releases
description: Morocco's national statistics office release feed - the only machine-readable HCP endpoint I could find. Entries are the actual headline statistical publications ('Situation du marche du travail au Maroc au deuxieme trimestre', 'Principaux indicateurs trimestriels retropoles provisoires du marche du travail') with title, link, updated date and summary.

name: ONS Algeria - Office National des Statistiques feed
description: Algeria's national statistics office SPIP backend feed - the only open machine-readable Algerian government source I could verify. Items include the consumer price index bulletin for Algiers and public consultations (e.g. 'Consultation relative au renouvellement des licences'), each with title, link, description and dc:date.

name: Mauritius open data - accident-prone road segments
description: 48 officially designated accident-prone road segments in Mauritius, each with _id, a named road descriptor ('M1: Belle Village up to Caudan') and the_geom as a MULTILINESTRING of WGS84 coordinates. The only resource on data.govmu.org whose datastore records carry a real label - the rest are raw spreadsheet dumps with 'Back to Table of Contents' headers.

name: PNCP - contratos publicados (federal/estadual/municipal)
description: Every public contract signed in Brazil in the window: supplier legal name and CNPJ (niFornecedor), contracting body CNPJ+razaoSocial, unit name/municipality/IBGE code, contract object text, signature date, validity start/end, process number, parliamentary amendment flag. numeroControlePNCP is the stable key into the contract detail hop.

name: PNCP - contratacoes (licitacoes) por data de publicacao
description: Tender notices: buying body CNPJ and razaoSocial, unit/municipality/UF/IBGE code, object of purchase, legal basis (amparoLegal), modality, dispute mode, estimated and homologated value, proposal open/close timestamps, process number, numeroControlePNCP.

name: PNCP - atas de registro de preco
description: Price-registration agreements: object text, agreement number and year, buying body CNPJ, signature date, validity window, cancellation flag and date, the system operator that published it, and the numeroControlePNCPCompra linking back to the originating tender.

name: PNCP - detalhe da contratacao por orgao/ano/sequencial
description: Second hop behind a tender row: full record for one contratacao - estimated vs homologated value, secrecy code, modality and dispute mode, legal basis text, buying body CNPJ/razaoSocial, unit, sub-rogated body, links to the origin system and the electronic process.

name: PNCP - itens de uma contratacao
description: Line items behind a tender: full item description, material-or-service flag, unit and total estimated value, quantity, unit of measure, judging criterion, benefit type (ME/EPP preference), item status, and inclusion/update timestamps. This is where over-pricing shows up.

name: PNCP - documentos anexos de uma contratacao
description: The actual documents behind a tender - edital, ETP (preliminary technical study), termo de referencia - each with title, document type, publication timestamp and a direct download URL. Auto-labels correctly ('titulo' is in K_TITLE).

name: PNCP - detalhe do contrato por orgao/ano/sequencial
description: Full contract record: supplier name and CNPJ, sub-contracted party fields, contracting body, contract/empenho number, category, signature date, validity window, retification count, and the involved-party/unit structure.

name: PNCP - documentos anexos de um contrato
description: Signed contract PDFs attached to a PNCP contract: title, document type, publication timestamp, and a direct download URL.

name: TCU - responsaveis inabilitados para funcao publica
description: Named individuals barred by the federal audit court from holding public office: full name, CPF, TCU process number, the deliberation (acordao) that imposed it, date of final judgment, expiry date of the bar, and UF/municipality. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: TCU - licitantes declarados inidoneos
description: Companies and people declared unfit to bid for federal contracts: legal name, CPF or CNPJ, TCU process number, acordao reference, date of final judgment, debarment expiry date, UF. The keyless counterpart to CEIS/CNEP. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Minha Receita - CNPJ completo com quadro societario
description: Full Receita Federal record for a CNPJ: razao_social, nome_fantasia, legal nature, size, share capital, registration status and date, CNAE, full address, phone, email - and qsa[], the named partners/officers with their qualification (Presidente, Socio-Administrador...), entry date, age band and masked CPF, plus legal representatives.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CNPJ.ws publica - empresa, socios e estabelecimentos
description: Second independent CNPJ source: razao_social, capital social, legal nature with code, responsible-party qualification, last-update timestamp, and socios[] with masked CPF/CNPJ, name, person type, entry date, age band, qualification object and country - plus the estabelecimento block (address, CNAE, status).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: CNPJa Open - office/company with members and roles
description: Third CNPJ source, English-keyed and the cleanest to parse: taxId, alias, founded date, head-office flag, status, and company.members[] each with person.id (a stable UUID), person.name, masked taxId, age band, country and role text - plus Simples/SIMEI opt-in history.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IPEAData OData - metadados das series
description: Catalogue of every IPEA economic/social series: SERCODIGO (the key into the values hop), SERNOME, a long methodological comment, source, unit, frequency, territorial level and status. 7.4MB, thousands of series, and each row opens a real time-series detail endpoint.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IPEAData OData - valores de uma serie
description: The observations behind one IPEA series: SERCODIGO, VALDATA, VALVALOR, and the territorial level/code (NIVNOME, TERCODIGO) the observation belongs to.

name: IPEAData OData - territorios
description: IPEA territorial dictionary: TERCODIGO, TERNOME, standardised name, capital flag, area in km2, territorial level and the minimum-comparable-area flag. Used to resolve the TERCODIGO carried on every series value.

name: IPEAData OData - paises
description: Country dictionary used by IPEA international series: PAICODIGO (ISO3) and PAINOME.

name: IPEAData OData - temas
description: Full theme tree for IPEA series: TEMCODIGO, parent theme TEMCODIGO_PAI and TEMNOME - 66 themes from Agropecuaria to Seguranca publica, giving the taxonomy for the 8k-series catalogue.

name: DATASUS/DEMAS - CNES estabelecimentos de saude
description: Every registered health establishment in Brazil: CNES code, CNPJ, nome_razao_social and nome_fantasia, management type, administrative sphere, unit type, full address with CEP, phone, e-mail, decimal lat/lon, municipality and UF codes, legal nature, and boolean capability flags (surgical centre, obstetric centre, hospital care, support services). Supports ?codigo_municipio= filtering.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DATASUS/DEMAS - CNES estabelecimento por codigo
description: Per-facility detail hop behind the CNES list: the same establishment record resolved by CNES code, including contact e-mail, coordinates, ownership/legal-nature code and de-registration reason code.

name: Camara dos Deputados - ficha do deputado
description: Detail hop behind the (already-collected) deputy list: civil name, electoral name, party and UF, legislature, photo URL, e-mail, office (gabinete) building/room/phone, CPF-adjacent biographical fields, birth date and birthplace.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Camara - frentes parlamentares de um deputado
description: Every parliamentary front (lobby caucus) a deputy belongs to - 227 for a single member - with front id, title and legislature. The cleanest keyless map of Brazilian legislative interest groups. Auto-labels on 'titulo'.

name: Camara - profissoes declaradas de um deputado
description: Self-declared professions of a deputy with the declaration timestamp and profession type code. Auto-labels on 'titulo'.

name: Camara - historico de status de um deputado
description: Party-switching and mandate history: one row per change with name, electoral name, party at that moment, UF, legislature number, timestamp, situation (Exercicio/Licenca/Vacancia), electoral condition (Titular/Suplente) and a prose description of what changed. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - detalhe de uma proposicao
description: Detail hop behind the proposition list: type/number/year, full ementa, presentation timestamp, and the statusProposicao block - current organ, last rapporteur URI, regime, tramitation description, situation, despacho text, scope and appreciation type.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Camara - autores de uma proposicao
description: Who actually filed a bill: author name, a deputy URI that resolves to the full member record, author type (Deputado/Orgao/Senador), signature order and a proponent flag. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - tramitacoes de uma proposicao
description: Docket entries behind a bill: timestamp, sequence number, acting organ (sigla + URI), rapporteur URI, regime, tramitation type and code, situation and code, and the full despacho text of each procedural act.

name: Camara - membros de um orgao/comissao
description: Who sits on a committee: deputy id and URI, name, party, UF, legislature, e-mail, photo, plus the role held (titulo/codTitulo - Presidente, Vice) with start and end dates. Officer-behind-the-body hop. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - eventos de um orgao/comissao
description: Sittings held by a committee: event id, start/end timestamps, situation, event type, agenda description, the organs involved (with sigla, full name, type), physical room, and the YouTube recording URL.

name: Camara - membros de um partido
description: Current bench of a party: deputy id and URI, name, party sigla, UF, legislature, photo URL and institutional e-mail. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - deputados presentes num evento
description: Attendance list for a specific sitting: each deputy's id, URI, name, party, UF, legislature, photo and e-mail - i.e. who was in the room. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: Camara - membros de um grupo parlamentar de amizade
description: Bilateral friendship group (e.g. Brasil/Armenia) with its id and name, carrying a membros[] array of 33 deputies each with name, deputy URI, role (Presidente, 1o Vice-Presidente), legislature and start/end dates. Set array_path 'dados' - auto-detection would otherwise pick the inner membros array.

name: Senado Federal - processos legislativos (API nova)
description: The replacement Senate API (the old materia/pesquisa service is deprecated). Flat top-level array: id, codigoMateria, identificacao (e.g. 'PL 1/2025'), full ementa, the complete authorship string naming every co-signing senator with party and state, presentation/deliberation/situation dates, current situation, deliberation outcome and the resulting law number. Has both 'id' and 'ementa'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Senado Federal - detalhe de um processo
description: 23kB detail hop behind each Senate process: identification, type, the conteudo block (norm type, ementa, indicated norm), the documento block (document id, type, text URLs) and the full tramitation/authorship structure.

name: Banco Central - expectativas de mercado (Focus) mensais
description: Focus survey: per indicator (IPCA, Cambio, Selic, PIB) and reference month - mean, median, standard deviation, min, max, number of responding institutions and the calculation basis. Note 'Indicador' and 'Data' do not match the auto key lists, so title_keys must be set explicitly.

name: Banco Central - taxas de juros por instituicao financeira
description: Ranked interest rates charged by each named Brazilian bank: period start/end, segment (PF/PJ), credit modality, ranking position, the institution's name, monthly and annual rate, and the first 8 digits of its CNPJ - which joins straight into the CNPJ sources above.

name: IBGE Localidades - municipio por codigo
description: Per-municipality detail hop (the list endpoint is already in the tree): IBGE code and name plus the full nested hierarchy - microrregiao, mesorregiao, UF with sigla, macro-region, and the immediate/intermediate region codes. Resolves the codigoIbge carried on every PNCP tender.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IBGE Localidades - distritos de um municipio
description: Sub-municipal districts behind a municipality - 96 for Sao Paulo - each with district id, name and the full municipio/microrregiao/mesorregiao/UF chain. Auto-labels on 'nome'.

name: IBGE Censo - frequencia de um nome/sobrenome
description: Census frequency of any given name or surname, broken down by birth decade (res[] with periodo and frequencia) and optionally by sex and locality. Useful for scoring how distinctive a Brazilian name is in identity work. Auto-labels on 'nome'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Georef Argentina - provincias
description: All 24 Argentine provinces with INDEC id, nombre and centroid lat/lon. Root of the georef normalisation chain that every other Argentine dataset's location codes resolve against. Auto-labels on 'nombre'.

name: Georef Argentina - departamentos
description: 529 departments with id, nombre, centroid and parent province (id + nombre). The ?id= detail hop was probed with a real id (06014) and returned the single matching record. Auto-labels on 'nombre'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Georef Argentina - municipios
description: Municipalities with id, nombre, centroid lat/lon and parent province. Also supports ?nombre= free-text search (verified with 'rosario', 9 hits). Auto-labels on 'nombre'.

name: Georef Argentina - localidades
description: Settlements with id, nombre, category, centroid, and the full parent chain - departamento, municipio, localidad_censal and provincia, each as id+nombre. Auto-labels on 'nombre'.

name: Georef Argentina - localidades censales
description: Census localities (the unit INDEC publishes population against): id, nombre, category (Localidad simple/compuesta), urban/rural function, centroid and parent departamento/municipio/provincia. Note the JSON key uses an underscore: localidades_censales.

name: Georef Argentina - asentamientos
description: Named settlements/hamlets below the locality level: id, nombre, category, centroid and the departamento/municipio/localidad_censal/provincia chain. Auto-labels on 'nombre'.

name: Georef Argentina - calles
description: Street-level gazetteer: street id, nombre, category (CALLE/AVENIDA), the full nomenclatura string, house-number ranges per side (altura.inicio/fin, derecha/izquierda) and the parent departamento/localidad_censal/provincia. This is what turns a free-text Argentine address into a normalised one.

name: BCRA - variables monetarias y cambiarias (v4)
description: Catalogue of 1,581 BCRA series (page size 1000): idVariable, descripcion, categoria, series type, periodicity, unit, currency, first and last reported date and the latest value. Note v3 is deprecated (HTTP 410) - v4 is the live path. 'descripcion' is not in K_TITLE so title_keys must be set.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: BCRA - maestro de divisas
description: BCRA currency master: ISO codigo and denominacion for the 44 currencies the central bank quotes. Small but it is the join key for the Cotizaciones endpoint.

name: BCRA - cotizaciones de divisas del dia
description: Official BCRA FX fixings for a given date: codigoMoneda, descripcion, tipoPase and tipoCotizacion for every quoted currency. The records live at results.detalle - results itself is an object carrying the fecha, so array_path must be given explicitly.

name: BCRA - Central de Deudores del Sistema Financiero por CUIT
description: Keyless CUIT -> credit-exposure lookup, the highest-penetrancy Argentine source I found: identificacion and denominacion (legal name) of the debtor, then per reporting period every named bank it owes money to, with BCRA situation grade 1-5, amount, days past due, and boolean flags for refinancing, forced recategorisation, legal proceedings (situacionJuridica, procesoJud), technical irrecoverability and under-review status. A /Historicas/{cuit} variant returns the multi-period history (verified, 60kB). Requires array_path 'results' + title_keys 'denominacion' - see notes.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DNCP Paraguay - procesos de contratacion por rango de fechas
description: OCDS record package for every Paraguayan procurement process touched in a date window - a date-driven sweep the tree does not have (only ?query= keyword search is present). Each record carries the ocid plus a releases[] array of dated release URLs tagged tender/award/implementation/contractAmendment, which are the detail hops. CRITICAL: array_path must be set to 'records' and title_keys to 'ocid' - auto-detection picks the inner releases array, whose entries would then label off the release id instead of the process.

name: DNCP Paraguay - release OCDS completo
description: The record behind the search hit, probed with a real release id: full OCDS release with ocid, date, tags, parties[] (219 'name' occurrences in the one release I fetched - buyers, procuring entities and every bidding supplier with their identifiers), tender block with title and items, and awards[] carrying award id, status, date, value with currency and the named winning suppliers. This is the award-and-supplier layer, not just a listing.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: SECOP II - Multas y Sanciones (Colombia Compra Eficiente)
description: Fines and sanctions imposed under SECOP II contracts. Each record gives the sanctioning entity name and code, the sanctioned supplier name and code, contract id, process id and reference, sanction type, act number, amount, amount paid, event date, whether guarantees were called, and status - a direct pivot from a vendor to its enforcement history.

name: SECOP - Convenios Interadministrativos
description: Inter-administrative agreements between Colombian public bodies: contract id, contracting entity name, load/signature/start/end dates, order, and contract value - the state-to-state contracting channel that sits outside ordinary tendering.

name: SECOP - Convenios Interadministrativos Historico
description: Historical archive of the same inter-administrative agreements, giving multi-year continuity for an entity's agreement history rather than only the live window.

name: SECOP I - Procesos de Compra Publica Historico
description: Full historical SECOP I tender file - process uid, contracting entity, object, modality, dates, budgeted and awarded values, and awarded supplier. Records carry an exact 'uid' key so they label cleanly.

name: SECOP II - Plan Anual de Adquisiciones (detalle)
description: Line-item annual procurement plans: entity, planned item, UNSPSC code, estimated value, expected award month, funding source and the named contact officer for the line - forward-looking intelligence on what an entity is about to buy and from whom it expects to buy it.

name: ANM Contratos Suscritos Consolidado (Agencia Nacional de Mineria)
description: Contracts signed by Colombia's National Mining Agency: contractor name, contract object, value, dates and type - links mining-sector vendors to the regulator that supervises the titles.

name: ANM RUCOM - Explotador Minero Autorizado (Titulo Minero)
description: Register of authorised mineral exploiters holding a mining title: named person or company, expediente code of the title, mineral, beneficiation plant, municipality, department and DANE code. This is the person behind the title, not the title alone.

name: ANM RUCOM - Solicitudes de Legalizacion/Formalizacion
description: Named applicants seeking legalisation or formalisation of informal mining, with expediente code, mineral, municipality and department - the pre-title pipeline of informal operators.

name: ANM RUCOM - Subcontratos de Formalizacion
description: Formalisation subcontracts sitting underneath a mining title: named subcontracted party, the parent titulo_minero, expediente code, mineral and location - the second layer of beneficiaries behind a single title.

name: ANM Volumen de Explotacion de Minerales Asociados a Pagos de Regalias
description: Declared extraction volumes tied to royalty payments, by municipality, mineral, period and title - lets declared output be cross-checked against royalties actually paid.

name: ANH Pozos exploratorios A2 y A3 (hidrocarburos)
description: Exploratory hydrocarbon wells: well name, operator, contract/block, basin, spud and completion dates and status - the operator-to-well mapping behind Colombian oil blocks.

name: Declaracion de activos y patrimonio de servidores publicos (Funcion Publica)
description: Asset and income declarations of Colombian public servants: document type and number, four name parts, form number, publication date, declaration status and type, employing entity, whether the declarant is a contractor, post, tax year, and boolean flags for reported income, bank accounts, patrimonial assets, debts, board/council memberships, corporate participations and private economic activity.

name: Declaraciones de conflictos de interes de servidores publicos
description: Conflict-of-interest declarations: named declarant with document number, entity, post and tax year, plus flags for spouse/partner, relatives with conflicts, direct interests in official acts, trusts creating conflicts, other conflicting investments, donations and residual conflicts - the relationship layer behind the asset declarations.

name: IPS para prestacion de servicios a Personas Privadas de la Libertad
description: Health providers contracted to serve the prison population: provider legal/trade name, identification, location and contracted service - a niche vendor set with recurring corruption exposure.

name: Novedades delictivas reportadas por servicios de vigilancia y seguridad privada
description: Criminal incidents reported by Colombia's licensed private security industry to the Superintendencia: service type name, incident class, department/municipality, date and counts - links the private security sector to the incidents it handles.

name: Relacion de IPS publicas y privadas segun nivel de atencion y capacidad instalada
description: Registered health providers with their care level and installed capacity: provider name, identification, nature (public/private), department/municipality and bed/service counts.

name: Directorio Georreferenciado de Prestadores de Servicios de Salud (REPS)
description: Geolocated directory of licensed Colombian health providers - provider name, NIT/identification, address, municipality, coordinates and enabled services.

name: DNP - Fiscalizacion de Produccion (regalias)
description: National Planning Department audit of extractive production feeding the royalties system, by territorial entity, resource and period.

name: Contratos INVIAS (Instituto Nacional de Vias)
description: Road-authority contract register - entity, contract number and object, contractor, value, dates and status. Large-ticket infrastructure contracting, the highest-value vendor set in Colombia.

name: MEN - Instituciones de Educacion Superior
description: Register of Colombian higher-education institutions: institution name and code, sector, character, accreditation status and location - the entity table that SNIES programme and enrolment data hangs off.

name: MEN - Directivos de Instituciones de Educacion Superior
description: Named directors and senior officers of higher-education institutions with their post and institution - the officer layer behind each university, useful for board/affiliation pivots.

name: Resultados unicos Saber Pro (ICFES)
description: Individual-level national higher-education exam results: institution name and code, programme, municipality, socio-economic stratum fields and module scores.

name: Resultados unicos Saber TyT (ICFES)
description: Individual-level technical and technological exam results with institution, programme and score breakdown - the vocational counterpart to Saber Pro.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos autorizados para almacenamiento y distribucion de medicamentos
description: Licensed medicine warehousing and distribution establishments: establishment name, NIT, address, municipality and authorisation status.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos nacionales fabricantes de medicamentos con BPM
description: Domestic pharmaceutical manufacturers certified in Good Manufacturing Practice: establishment name, certificate number, issue and expiry dates, address and certified lines.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos internacionales fabricantes de medicamentos con BPM
description: Foreign pharmaceutical plants certified by INVIMA for the Colombian market - establishment name, country, certificate and validity. Cross-border manufacturer identification.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos nacionales acondicionadores de productos con BPM
description: Certified product-conditioning/packaging establishments with certificate number, validity and address - the repackaging tier of the pharmaceutical chain.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos nacionales certificados con Buenas Practicas de Elaboracion
description: Establishments certified in Good Elaboration Practice, with certificate identifiers, validity window and address.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos nacionales con Buenas Practicas de Laboratorio
description: Domestic laboratories certified in Good Laboratory Practice - name, certificate, validity, address and scope.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos internacionales con Buenas Practicas de Laboratorio
description: Foreign laboratories certified by INVIMA, with country, certificate number and validity - foreign-entity identification through a domestic regulator.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos inscritos para manejo de medicamentos de control especial
description: Establishments licensed to handle controlled medicines (narcotics/psychotropics): trade or legal name, identification, address and municipality - the licensed handlers of diversion-prone substances.

name: INVIMA - IPS certificadas en Buenas Practicas Clinicas
description: Health institutions certified to run clinical trials, with certificate number, validity, city and address.

name: INVIMA - Instituciones certificadas en capacidad de produccion para productos cosmeticos
description: Cosmetics manufacturers certified for production capacity - establishment name, certificate, validity and address.

name: INVIMA - Establecimientos autorizados para importar carne y derivados carnicos
description: Foreign meat plants authorised to export to Colombia: establishment name and code, country, product categories and authorisation status - a named cross-border importer/exporter list.

name: Consulta publica de Precios de Medicamentos (SISMED)
description: Reported medicine prices by product, laboratory, presentation, channel and period - lets procurement prices paid by public bodies be benchmarked against reported market prices.

name: INVIMA - Medicamentos vitales no disponibles
description: Vital-but-unavailable medicines authorised for exceptional import: commercial name, active ingredient, applicant/importer, authorisation number and dates.

name: INVIMA - Registros sanitarios y NSO vigentes y vencidas
description: Sanitary registrations and mandatory health notifications, live and expired, with holder, address, registration number, product and validity window.

name: Superintendencia Financiera - Quejas interpuestas ante entidades vigiladas
description: Consumer complaints lodged against supervised financial entities and consumer ombudsmen: entity name and code, product, complaint motive, channel, period and counts - a misconduct signal per financial institution.

name: Superintendencia Financiera - Quejas de consumidores contra entidades vigiladas
description: Complaints filed directly with the regulator against supervised entities, by entity, product, motive and period - the escalated tier above in-house complaints.

name: Superintendencia Financiera - Directivos de entidades publicas vigiladas
description: Reported directors and senior officers of public entities supervised by the financial regulator, with entity type and name and the officer's post - the officer layer behind supervised institutions.

name: Superintendencia Financiera - Balance de entidades publicas vigiladas
description: CUIF supervisory financial statements by currency for supervised entities: entity type and name, account code, currency and balance - line-item financials per regulated institution.

name: Listado de Entidades del Sector Solidario (cooperativas y fondos)
description: Register of Colombian cooperatives, employee funds and mutual associations: entity name, NIT, class, supervision level, municipality and status - a company-registry slice that ordinary commercial registries miss.

name: Superintendencia Financiera - Puntos de atencion de canales por municipio
description: Physical presence of each financial institution by municipality and channel type (branches, agents, ATMs) - maps an institution's real footprint including in remote municipalities.

name: Superservicios - Registro de Areas de Prestacion del Servicio
description: Registered service areas of Colombian public-utility companies: company name and NIT/registration id, service type, department, municipality and area - which company holds which utility territory.

name: Base de Datos de Concesionarios (vehiculos)
description: Registered vehicle dealerships with name, identification, brand represented, address and municipality.

name: DNP - Proyectos del Sistema General de Regalias
description: Royalty-funded investment projects: project name and BPIN code, executing entity, sector, department/municipality, approved value and status - where extractive royalties actually land.

name: DNP - Proyectos, datos basicos (banco de proyectos de inversion)
description: National investment project bank core records: project name, BPIN, sponsoring entity, sector, phase, dates and value - the master project table the royalty and budget execution feeds join to.

name: OVCF - SGR - Programacion de Ingresos
description: Programmed royalty revenue by receiving entity, fund, budget item and period - entity-level royalty entitlements.

name: OVCF - SGR - Ejecucion de Gastos
description: Actual royalty spending execution by entity, fund, budget line and period - the paired outflow against the programmed revenue, so under-execution and diversion are visible per entity.

name: Poblacion Base de Datos Unica de Afiliados (BDUA) - regimen subsidiado
description: Subsidised-regime health affiliation counts broken down by EPS, department/municipality, regime, age band and gender label - the affiliation base that per-capita payments to insurers are computed from.

name: Caja de Seguro Social - Planilla Institucional 2026 (Panama)
description: Full January 2026 payroll of Panama's social security institution, 35,549 rows total: employee name, national ID (cedula) number, position code, post, monthly salary, start-of-service date, expense object and employment status. Named-individual + national-ID resolution at scale.

name: Caja de Seguro Social - Planilla Institucional 2025 (Panama)
description: Same CSS payroll for January 2025, 34,958 rows - year-on-year comparison exposes hires, departures and salary jumps for named officials.

name: Contraloria General de la Republica - Planilla Institucional 2026 (Panama)
description: Payroll of Panama's national audit institution, 4,838 rows: name, surname, gender, position number, cedula, post, post code, monthly salary, supplementary pay, start date and expense object.

name: Contraloria General - Contrataciones de Personal 2025 (Panama)
description: New hires at the Comptroller General, 694 rows: name, surname, cedula, start of service, post, post code and monthly salary - the hiring stream rather than the standing headcount.

name: Registro Publico de Panama - Planilla Institucional
description: Payroll of Panama's Public Registry (the corporate/property registrar), 755 rows: employee number, name, surname, cedula, structural post, function, salary, representation expenses, directorate/region, department and start date - staff of the body that registers Panamanian companies.

name: Metro de Panama S.A. - Planilla Regular 2026
description: Payroll of the state metro operator, 827 rows: position, name, surname, cedula, post, monthly salary, start of service, expense object and status.

name: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama - Planilla 2026
description: February 2026 payroll of the banking regulator, 432 rows: position, name, surname, gender, cedula, post, post code, salary, supplement, start date and expense object - staff of the supervisor of Panama's offshore banking sector.

name: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panama - Planilla 2025
description: February 2025 payroll of the same banking regulator, 429 rows, same field set - the prior-year snapshot for turnover analysis.

name: Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores - Planilla Institucional 2026 (Panama)
description: Payroll of Panama's securities regulator, 114 rows: position, name, surname, gender, cedula, post, post code, salary, supplement, start date.

name: Tribunal de Cuentas - Planilla 2026 (Panama)
description: Payroll of the court that tries public-funds accountability cases, 137 rows: name, surname, gender, position, cedula, post, post code, monthly salary, supplement, start date and expense object.

name: Ministerio de Gobierno - Planilla 2026 (Panama)
description: Interior Ministry payroll, 3,272 rows: position, name, surname, gender, cedula, post, post code, salary, supplement, start date and expense object - includes the prison and immigration-adjacent workforce.

name: IPHE - Planilla Institucional 2025 (Panama)
description: Payroll of the Panamanian Institute for Special Habilitation, 2,232 rows with name, surname, gender, position, cedula, post, salary, supplement and start date.

name: Autoridad de Aseo Urbano y Domiciliario - Planilla 2024 (Panama)
description: Urban sanitation authority payroll, 2,250 rows: employee number, name, surname, structural post, department, cedula, social security number, start date, status, salary and employee type - carries the social-security number as well as the cedula.

name: Autoridad de los Recursos Acuaticos - Planilla Institucional (Panama)
description: Aquatic resources authority payroll, 405 rows: position, name, surname, cedula number, post, monthly salary, start of service, expense object and status - the fisheries/flag-adjacent regulator.

name: SENACYT - Planilla Institucional (Panama)
description: National science and technology secretariat payroll, 1,951 rows: position, post code, post description, payroll salary, representation expenses, name, surname and cedula.

name: Universidad Maritima Internacional de Panama - Planilla Regular
description: Payroll of Panama's international maritime university, 262 rows: count, position, name, cedula, structural post, salary and condition - staff of the training body behind Panama's ship registry ecosystem.

name: Autoridad de Pasaportes de Panama - Planilla 2024
description: Payroll of the Passport Authority, 152 rows: name, surname, gender, position, cedula, post, post code, salary, supplement, start of service and expense object - staff of the body issuing Panamanian travel documents.

name: Empresa Nacional de Autopista - Planilla 2025 (Panama)
description: State toll-road company payroll: position, name, surname, gender, cedula, post, post code, monthly salary, supplement, start of service and expense object.

name: Municipio de Tonosi - Planilla municipal (Panama)
description: Municipal payroll, 180 rows with name, surname, gender, position, cedula, post, post code, salary, supplement, start date and expense object - shows the same named-official disclosure reaches down to municipal level.

name: SERTV - Contrataciones Publicas 2026 (Panama)
description: Awarded public tenders of the state broadcaster, 245 rows: public act number, act name, purchase type, AWARDED COMPANY, act date, item description, quantity, unit value and purchase value. Records also carry a mojibake 'Nombre del Acto P£blico Adjudicado' column; '_id' is the safe exact label key.

name: SERTV - Contrataciones Publicas 2024 (Panama)
description: Same award register for 2024, 798 rows - award-by-award supplier history for one contracting entity across years.

name: ASEP - Concesiones electricas en operacion 2026 (Panama)
description: Generation concessions in commercial operation, 405 rows: month, CONCESSION-HOLDING COMPANY, project name, resource exploited, province, district, corregimiento, installed MW, start of operation and current condition - company-to-asset mapping for Panama's power sector.

name: ASEP - Concesiones en Operacion Comercial 2025 (Panama)
description: Prior-year concession register, 540 rows, same fields - reveals changes of concession holder between years.

name: Servicio Nacional de Migracion - Viaticos internacionales 2023 (Panama)
description: International travel allowances of immigration service officials: cedula, name, surname, post, destination, details, start and end dates, total, per-diem and report file - places named immigration officials in specific countries on specific dates.

name: Superintendencia de Bancos - Misiones Oficiales Nacionales 2025 (Panama)
description: Official missions of banking-regulator staff: start and end dates, name, surname, cedula, destination, per-diem amount and details - who from the bank supervisor travelled where and when.

name: MEDUCA - Fondo de Equidad y Calidad de la Educacion (FECE) 2022 (Panama)
description: National transparency report on funds transferred to individual schools, 1,750 rows: project/programme name, school, region, amounts transferred and executed - grant-level tracking of education money to named recipients.

name: IDAAN - Listado de tomas de agua cruda (Panama)
description: Raw-water intake points of the national water utility: intake name, easting/northing coordinates, province, district, corregimiento, watershed, source and type - named critical water infrastructure with coordinates.

name: Diario Oficial de la Federacion - SIDOF notas del dia (Mexico)
description: Undocumented JSON API behind Mexico's official gazette. One call for a date (DD-MM-YYYY) returns NotasMatutinas, NotasVespertinas and NotasExtraordinarias; each nota has codNota, section, date, diario id, issuing branch name (nombreCodOrgaUno), issuing secretariat (codOrgaDos), page range, order, status and flags for available HTML/DOC/PDF/image. DETAIL VERIFIED: /dof/sidof/notas/nota/5796377 returned a 33KB single Nota object with the full text and title - so every gazette entry can be expanded to its actual decree, appointment or sanction. Note: the tree already has www.dof.gob.mx scrapes but not this API host.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: DANE Colombia - Catalogo de Microdatos (NADA API)
description: National statistics office microdata catalogue. Each row: internal id, idno, study title, nation, authoring entity, form model, year range, repository id, data-access link, created/changed timestamps, view and download counts and study URL. DETAIL VERIFIED: /api/catalog/MINTIC-OAPES-INTERNET-2010-A-2014 returned a 29KB study object with full DDI metadata - producers, funding agencies, sampling, coverage, contacts (name/affiliation/email) and variable count. The named producers and contacts behind each dataset are the penetrancy here.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: INE Bolivia - ANDA Archivo Nacional de Datos (NADA API)
description: Bolivian national statistics microdata catalogue, same NADA schema: id, idno, title, nation, authoring entity, form model, year range, repository, REDATAM data-access link, timestamps, views and downloads. DETAIL VERIFIED: /api/catalog/BOL-INE-CA-2013 (Censo Agropecuario 2013) returned a 38KB study record with producers, contacts, topics, collection dates and keywords. Bolivia is otherwise almost absent from the tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Plataforma Digital Unica del Estado Peruano - busqueda JSON (gob.pe)
description: Undocumented JSON search endpoint covering the whole Peruvian state portal - 444,822 indexed items including 337,743 normas legales, 86,023 publicaciones, 18,309 noticias and 15 institutions. Each result: id, document_type, publication date, subject (the title), name_with_parent (issuing institution path), collections, url, searchable_type, official_document_type, content excerpt and relevance score. Free-text term and content-type filters make it a general pivot over Peruvian legal instruments and official notices by company or person name. Host www.gob.pe already appears in the tree but only as landing-page scrapes, not this endpoint.

name: Knesset — agenda motions (KNS_Agenda)
description: Motions for the agenda: motion name, classification, Knesset number, urgency subtype, status, InitiatorPersonID and MinisterPersonID (pivot to KNS_Person), CommitteeID, government recommendation and postponement reason.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — bill name history (KNS_BillName)
description: Every historical title a bill carried, with the reading stage the title belonged to (NameHistoryTypeDesc). Lets you track a bill through renames; BillID pivots to the bill record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — bill initiators (KNS_BillInitiator)
description: The person-behind-the-bill join table: BillID, PersonID, IsInitiator (lead vs co-signer) and Ordinal. This is what turns a bill into a named MK. Label is the timestamp+numeric fallback — no name-ish key on the record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — bill documents (KNS_DocumentBill)
description: Per-bill document manifest: GroupTypeDesc (e.g. extract from Knesset proceedings), application type, and FilePath — a direct fs.knesset.gov.il URL to the actual .doc/.pdf. Label is timestamp+numeric fallback.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — committee sessions (KNS_CommitteeSession)
description: Committee sitting records: room/location, committee id, open-vs-closed type, status, start and finish datetimes, plus SessionUrl and BroadcastUrl.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — committee agenda items (KNS_CmtSessionItem)
description: The individual items discussed inside a committee sitting: item name, ordinal, status, item type, and the CommitteeSessionID / ItemID that link back to the session and to the underlying bill or query.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — committee protocols (KNS_DocumentCommitteeSession)
description: Verbatim committee protocol files: GroupTypeDesc identifies the protocol type and FilePath is a direct fs.knesset.gov.il link to the transcript document. Label is timestamp+numeric fallback.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — parliamentary questions (KNS_Query)
description: Parliamentary questions to ministers: subject, urgency type, status, asking PersonID, answering GovMinistryID, submit date and minister reply date. Direct MK-to-ministry accountability trail.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — question documents (KNS_DocumentQuery)
description: Documents attached to parliamentary questions, with FilePath pointing at the actual question/answer .doc on fs.knesset.gov.il. Label is timestamp+numeric fallback.

name: Knesset — person to position (KNS_PersonToPosition)
description: Full office history per person: PositionID, Knesset number, start and finish dates, ministry name, duty description, faction name, government number, committee name and IsCurrent. The core career-graph table for Israeli politicians.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — parliamentary factions (KNS_Faction)
description: Every faction across all Knessets: name, Knesset number, start and finish dates, IsCurrent flag. Resolves faction_id seen on vote records.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — government ministries (KNS_GovMinistry)
description: Ministry register with IsActive flag; resolves GovMinistryID appearing on questions, laws and position records.

name: Knesset — Israeli laws (KNS_IsraelLaw)
description: Consolidated statute register: law name, IsBasicLaw, IsBudgetLaw, first and latest publication dates, validity status and validity start/finish dates with notes.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — statute name history (KNS_IsraelLawName)
description: Historical names of each consolidated statute, joined to both IsraelLawID and the specific LawID amendment that introduced the name.

name: Knesset — enacted laws and amendments (KNS_Law)
description: Each enactment/amendment as published: name, type and subtype (incl. Mandate-era British statutes), Knesset number, publication date, publication series, gazette number and page number.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — law amendment graph (KNS_LawBinding)
description: Which enactment amends which statute: LawID, IsraelLawID, ParentLawID, binding type (original law vs amendment), amendment type (direct/indirect) and page number. Label is timestamp+numeric fallback.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — terms and sessions calendar (KNS_KnessetDates)
description: Knesset term register: term name, Knesset number, assembly and plenum ordinals, plenum start and finish dates, IsCurrent.

name: Knesset — plenum agenda items (KNS_PlmSessionItem)
description: Items on each plenary sitting agenda: item name, item type description, ordinal, status and IsDiscussion, linked by PlenumSessionID and ItemID.

name: Knesset — plenum vote headers (approved)
description: One row per plenary vote: session and item descriptions, vote item description, date and time, electronic flag, is_accepted, and the for/against/abstain totals. Pivots to the 79-row per-MK breakdown behind each vote.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset — MK identity index (voting service)
description: MK roster used by the voting service: vip_id, mk_individual_id, and surname and first name in both Hebrew and English. The bridge between vote rows and named people.

name: Knesset Research and Information Center — documents
description: Every MMM research paper: Hebrew and English title and abstract, publication date, system date, working days, doc type, filename, bibliography and named experts. Pivots to the authoring researchers.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset Research and Information Center — researchers
description: The named researchers and external experts behind MMM papers: surname and first name in Hebrew and English, academic title, gender, system date. Joins to documents via document_people.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Knesset Research and Information Center — keyword vocabulary
description: Controlled subject vocabulary for MMM papers, Hebrew and English, resolving keyword_id on the document_keyword join table.

name: Israel Registrar of Companies — changes and charges on corporations
description: Per-corporation change events: corporation number, corporation name, request type (e.g. registration of a charge/pledge), status update date, charge id and request type code. The charge/security-interest trail behind an Israeli company.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Israel Registrar of Companies — companies marked for striking off
description: Corporations in the deletion pipeline: corporation number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type, status and sub-status (in deletion proceedings / dissolved by deletion), and publication date of the notice.

name: Israel Registrar of Partnerships
description: Registered partnerships: partnership number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type (incl. foreign partnerships), status, incorporation date and registered address (city, street, house number).

name: Israel Registrar of Non-Profits — registered amutot
description: Full NGO register: amuta number, registration date, Hebrew and English name, status and status-update date, activity classification and registered address. 24 columns per record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Israel NGOs — donations from foreign state entities
description: Statutory foreign-funding disclosures: amuta number, amuta name, date the donation was received, the NAMED foreign political entity that gave it, and the donor-entity type code. Direct foreign-influence tracing.

name: Israel NGOs — proper management certificate (ishur nihul takin)
description: Year-by-year compliance certificate status per amuta: amuta number and name, certificate year, whether an application was filed, whether the certificate was granted, and last record update.

name: Israel Registrar — public benefit companies (chevrot le-toelet ha-tsibur)
description: CLG-equivalent public benefit companies: registration number, registration date, Hebrew and English name, status, formal objects and activity classification.

name: Israel Official Receiver — companies in liquidation
description: Court liquidation files: file id, company city of operation, file status, petition filing date, date the winding-up order was granted, and date the order was cancelled or frozen.

name: Israel Official Receiver — proofs of debt in bankruptcy and liquidation
description: Creditor claims filed against insolvent estates: claimant class (private/institutional), claim status, system (bankruptcy vs liquidation), debt creation date and the case id the claim attaches to.

name: Israel Official Receiver — individual bankruptcy debtors
description: Personal bankruptcy files: running file number, debtor's city of residence, name of the district court, file status, file opening date, receivership order date and subsequent order dates.

name: Israel — companies in expedited voluntary liquidation
description: Fast-track voluntary winding-up: company number, Hebrew and English name, corporation type, current status, date the liquidation request was approved, expected dissolution date and sub-status.

name: Israel Registrar of Pledges (rasham ha-mashkonot)
description: Secured-interest register: pledge id, registration date, registration status, reason-for-status and status date, asset registration date and asset removal date. Collateral history on Israeli debtors.

name: Israel Registrar of Public Trusts (hekdeshot)
description: Public endowment/trust register: file number, registration date, trust name, stated purposes and funding method. Sibling resources on the same dataset carry the trust's real estate and remaining asset balances.

name: Israel Registrar of Political Parties
description: Registered political parties: party name, registrar party number and the party's full declared objects text.

name: Israel — licensed notaries register
description: Named notaries with licence file number, full name, town and the languages they are certified to notarise in.

name: Israel — certified public accountants register
description: CPA roll: licence number, date the licence was granted, first and last name, town, and practice status (including self-declared non-practising).

name: Israel — licensed real estate brokers
description: Active licensed brokers: licence number, broker full name and city of residence.

name: Israel — licensed private investigators
description: Named licensed private investigators with surname, first name and licence number.

name: Israel — licensed land appraisers (shamai mekarke'in)
description: Appraiser roll: appraiser name, licence number, file number and city.

name: Israel — register of patent attorneys
description: Patent attorney roll with licence number, title, surname and first name, year entered on the register, fee year paid, EMAIL ADDRESS, street address, town and postcode.

name: Israel — prosecutors authorised by the Attorney General
description: Named external and internal prosecutors carrying AG authorisation: first and last name, prosecutor type, statutory basis of the authorisation, the requesting public body, authorisation start and end dates and termination reason.

name: Israel — state engagements with external law firms
description: Committee for the engagement of external counsel: request id, the government body making the request, request date, and the NAMED law firms considered or selected with the selection method. Government-to-private-counsel money trail.

name: Israel Trademark Office — trademark register
description: Trademark records: mark number, figurative flag, link to the official extract on trademarks.justice.gov.il, legal state, national vs international, international mark number, and mark description in Hebrew and English.

name: Israel Trademark Office — holders and licensees
description: The owner-behind-the-mark table: national mark number, client type (individual / foreign corporation), client number, client name in Hebrew and English, client standing (owner vs licensee) and lead-client flag.

name: Israel Patent Office — patent applications
description: Patent applications back to 1917: application number, request and filing dates, invention title in Hebrew and English, international application number and publication number.

name: Israel Patent Office — applicants behind patent applications
description: Applicant entity per application: application number, invention title in Hebrew and English, APPLICANT NAME and APPLICANT ADDRESS in Hebrew and English. Links inventions to named companies and firms.

name: Israel Patent Office — named inventors
description: Inventor names attached to each patent application, in Hebrew and English, with the invention title. Sample record is an electromagnetic gun system — includes defence-adjacent filings.

name: Israel Registrar of Inheritance — applications filed
description: Succession applications: filing date, application type (succession order vs probate), district, whether represented by counsel, application status, publication date and the newspaper that published the notice.

name: Israel — anti human-trafficking coordination unit case file
description: Cases handled by the National Anti-Trafficking Coordinator: case status and status date, opening and closing dates, case type, referral status and date, case subject (e.g. slavery) and the referring body.

name: Israel Appeals Tribunal (immigration/entry) — decisions register
description: Tribunal decision index: application number, case number, which tribunal (e.g. Beer Sheva), the NAMED adjudicator, decision date, application type and subject (e.g. family reunification).

name: Israel — decisive land appraisal decisions (shumot machriot)
description: Betterment-levy appraisal rulings with English column names: appraisal_header naming both parties, appraisal_type, appraiser_type, block and parcel, and the local planning committee. Names private parties against municipal committees.

name: Israel Privacy Protection Authority — registry of personal databases
description: Registered personal-data databases: database number, OWNER ID NUMBER (corporate registration number), owner full name, database name, and the owner's city, street, house number and postbox. Maps which company holds which personal dataset.

name: Israel Police — crime case records by area and quarter
description: Case-level crime records with a fictive case id, year and quarter, locality code and name, and the full police hierarchy: district code and name, region code and name, station code and name, plus offence grouping.

name: Saudi Arabia Etimad — public tenders (visitor feed)
description: Live national procurement feed: tender name and number, reference number, contracting AGENCY NAME and branch name, tender type and status, activity classification, conditions-booklet price, financial fees, invitation cost, and last-enquiry / offer-submission / offer-opening dates in both Gregorian and Hijri. Opaque per-tender id tenderIdString is present but the detail page is JS-challenge protected.

name: Saudi Arabia Etimad — government contracting agencies
description: Complete roster of 1,814 Saudi government contracting entities: government agency code, agency code, Arabic and English name, and legacy-system flag. Resolves agencyCode on every Etimad tender.

name: Saudi Arabia Etimad — administrative regions
description: The 13 Saudi administrative regions with id and Arabic name, used to geo-filter the Etimad tender feed.

name: Izmir Metropolitan Municipality — council members
description: Named elected council members: serial number, FULL NAME, office held (e.g. Metropolitan Mayor), profession and level of education. New host, not previously in the tree.

name: Izmir — sister-city and cooperation protocols
description: Municipal foreign relations: agreement type (cooperation protocol / sister city), domestic vs foreign, partner COUNTRY and CITY, council resolution number and council resolution date.

name: Bahrain — national-origin exports 2025 (HS line items)
description: 19,901 customs line items: year, month, 8-digit HS commodity code, commodity description (EN and AR), UN country code and destination country name (EN and AR), export value in BHD and USD, weight in kg, quantity and unit of measure. Filterable by partner country, which makes it a working trade-partner pivot for UAE, Saudi and Qatar.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Bahrain — total exports 2026 (HS line items)
description: 24,241 current-year export line items with the same schema: HS code, commodity in English and Arabic, UN code and destination country, value in BHD and USD, weight, quantity and unit.

name: Bahrain — imports 2021 (HS line items)
description: 314,055 import line items: month, HS code, commodity in English and Arabic, origin country code and name, import value in BHD and USD, weight in kg, quantity and unit of measure.

name: Bahrain — inward FDI stocks by counterparty country
description: Annual FDI stock in BHD millions per source country, with geographical region and geographical group classification. Includes offshore jurisdictions such as the Bahamas.

name: Bahrain — quarterly inward FDI stocks by country
description: Quarterly FDI stock in BHD millions by counterparty country with year, quarter, geographical region and group. 4,347 rows, current through 2026 Q1.

name: Bahrain — travel and cargo service establishments
description: 352 NAMED commercial establishments: trading name in English and Arabic, activity type and subtype in both languages (e.g. boat rentals), block number and longitude/latitude. A geolocated business directory, not a statistical table.

name: Bahrain — air quality monitoring stations
description: Named stations with English and Arabic name, operational status, station type (urban/industrial), latitude and longitude in DMS and decimal, and a geo_point field.

name: Qatar — judges serving at courts by title and nationality
description: Judicial bench composition by year: job title in English and Arabic (down to Vice-President of the Supreme Court), Qatari vs non-Qatari nationality, gender and headcount. Shows the foreign-national share of the Qatari judiciary.

name: Qatar — traffic casualties by traffic department
description: 720 rows: year, NAMED traffic department (e.g. Al Shamal), role of the affected person (driver/passenger/pedestrian), gender, outcome (death vs injury) and headcount, each with an Arabic parallel column.

name: Qatar — coastal environmental monitoring by location
description: 728 measurements: named parameter (English and Arabic), named monitoring location including the national permissible maximum, measured value and year.

name: Oman national data portal — dataset and indicator search
description: Knoema-backed search over the Omani national data portal: each item carries title, short title, region object with ISO code, indicator, keywords, popularity rank and a resolvable dataset url plus previewUrl/embedUrl. The only Omani endpoint that answered — data.gov.om serves nothing on CKAN or ODS API shapes.

name: NSE India - corporate announcements (equities)
description: Live regulated-disclosure stream for every NSE-listed Indian company. Per filing: sm_name (company legal name), sm_isin, symbol, smIndustry, an_dt and exchdisstime (filing vs dissemination time), desc (disclosure category), attchmntText (full narrative of what was disclosed) and attchmntFile (direct PDF URL), plus hasXbrl and seq_id.

name: NSE Emerge - corporate announcements (SME board)
description: Same disclosure schema restricted to the NSE Emerge SME platform, where smaller and less-scrutinised issuers file. Gives sm_name, sm_isin, symbol, filing timestamp, disclosure category and the attachment PDF for each SME filing.

name: NSE India - debt-segment corporate announcements
description: Disclosures by issuers of listed debt (NBFCs, private placements, municipal bonds). Same fields as the equity feed: issuer name, ISIN, timestamp, narrative text and PDF. Surfaces entities with no listed equity that are otherwise invisible in market data.

name: NSE India - InvIT and REIT announcements
description: Disclosure feed for Indian infrastructure investment trusts and real-estate investment trusts (Cube Highways Trust, Nxt-Infra Trust and peers): trust name, ISIN, filing time, category and the underlying document URL. These vehicles hold road, power and property assets and rarely appear in company-registry data.

name: NSE India - mutual fund / ETF announcements
description: AMC-level filings for exchange-traded funds and closed-end schemes: fund house name, scheme symbol, NAV declarations, timestamp and narrative text.

name: NSE India - board meeting intimations (equities)
description: Forward-looking board-meeting calendar: sm_name (company), bm_symbol, sm_isin, bm_date (the meeting date), bm_purpose and bm_desc (what will be considered - results, fund raising, ESOP, capital increase, arrangement schemes), bm_timestamp and the intimation attachment. Advance signal of corporate events before they happen.

name: NSE Emerge - board meeting intimations (SME)
description: Board-meeting calendar for the SME platform: company name, symbol, meeting date, stated purpose and full description of the agenda, plus the filed intimation document.

name: NSE India - corporate actions (equities)
description: Dividends, splits, bonuses, rights and buybacks: comp (company name), isin, symbol, series, faceVal, subject (the action and its rupee terms), exDate, recDate, book-closure and no-delivery windows. Ties a named issuer to a dated cash or equity event.

name: NSE Emerge - corporate actions (SME)
description: Dividend / split / bonus actions on the SME board with company name, ISIN, symbol, face value, ex-date and record date.

name: NSE India - debt corporate actions (interest and redemption)
description: Interest-payment and redemption events on listed debt, including municipal issuers such as Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation: comp (issuer), isin, symbol, faceVal (coupon), subject (Interest Payment / Redemption), recDate and series. Maps bond ISINs to named public and private issuers.

name: NSE India - quarterly financial results filings (equities)
description: 3,816 quarterly-results filings in one response: companyName, isin, symbol, audited/un-audited flag, consolidated vs standalone, financialYear, fromDate/toDate of the period, filingDate, broadCastDate, exchdisstime, indAs format and the XBRL/PDF link. A complete filing-history spine for listed Indian issuers.

name: NSE Emerge - quarterly financial results filings (SME)
description: 680 SME-platform results filings with companyName, ISIN, audit status, consolidation basis, reporting period, filing and dissemination timestamps and the results document.

name: NSE India - credit rating actions
description: 244 credit-rating disclosures: CompanyName (including unlisted borrowers marked NOTLISTED), ISIN, NameOfCRAgency (CRISIL, ICRA, Infomerics, CARE...), CreditRating, RatingAction (Reaffirm / Upgrade / Downgrade), DateofCR and BroadcastDateTime. Links a named borrower to a dated rating action and the agency that issued it.

name: NSE India - open and upcoming IPOs
description: Currently open public issues: companyName, symbol, series, issueStartDate, issueEndDate, issuePrice band, issueSize (shares) and status. Identifies companies raising public money right now.

name: NSE India - bulk and block deals (large trades with counterparty names)
description: High-penetrancy: names the actual counterparty behind each large trade. Per deal: clientName (the buying/selling entity, e.g. ARIHANT CAPITAL MARKETS LIMITED), name (the traded company), symbol, buySell direction, qty, watp (weighted average traded price), date and remarks. This is a named-entity-to-named-entity transaction record.

name: NSE India - daily capital-market report files
description: Directory of the day's official bhavcopy and surveillance report archives: name (report title), type, category, section and a direct link to each CSV/ZIP on nsearchives.nseindia.com. Entry point to the full daily trade and price record.

name: NSE India - all indices snapshot
description: 139 index rows: key (index group), index and indexSymbol, last/open/high/low/previousClose, variation and percentChange, yearHigh/yearLow, pe, pb, dy, advances/declines/unchanged counts and 30d/365d change. Sector-level market state for India.

name: NSE India - trading holiday calendar
description: Official market-closure calendar per segment: tradingDate, weekDay, description (the reason, including one-off closures such as a Maharashtra municipal election) and morning/evening session flags. Useful for dating gaps in any Indian market time series.

name: NSE India - live index option contracts
description: 1,560 live derivative contracts: identifier (unique contract code), underlying, instrumentType, contract, expiryDate, optionType, strikePrice, lastPrice, change, pChange, open/high/low and volume. Contract-level granularity on Indian index derivatives.

name: India mutual fund scheme master (AMFI-derived)
description: Full master list of 37,764 Indian mutual fund schemes: schemeCode (the AMFI code used as the join key everywhere), schemeName, isinGrowth and isinDivReinvestment. Resolves an Indian mutual fund ISIN or scheme code to its official name and fund house.

name: India mutual fund scheme name search
description: Name-pivot over the Indian mutual fund universe: returns schemeCode and schemeName for every scheme matching a free-text query. Dispatchable with a fund house or sponsor name to enumerate all of its schemes.

name: NITI Aayog - press releases (Drupal JSON:API)
description: Official releases from India's central policy think tank, delivered as JSON:API: stable uuid at the record root plus attributes.title, attributes.created/changed, body and the attached document fields. The only Indian central-government host of ~25 swept with JSON:API left open.

name: NITI Aayog - tender archive
description: Historic NITI Aayog tenders as structured nodes: uuid, attributes.title (tender subject), created and changed dates, and the attached tender document. A procurement trail for a central body whose tenders are otherwise only on CPPP HTML.

name: NITI Aayog - RTI proactive disclosure: foreign visits
description: Section 4(1)(b) RTI proactive disclosure of official foreign travel by NITI Aayog officials: uuid, attributes.title naming the visit, publication dates and the linked disclosure document. Direct official-travel record for named public servants.

name: NITI Aayog - official notifications
description: Formal notifications issued by NITI Aayog with uuid, attributes.title, issue and change timestamps and the notification file.

name: NITI Aayog - what's new feed
description: Rolling notice board of new NITI Aayog items (vacancies, consultations, launches) with uuid, attributes.title, created/changed timestamps and attachment links.

name: NITI Aayog - reports and publications
description: 44 policy reports with uuid, attributes.title, full body text, publication dates and the PDF file reference. Response is ~1.5 MB, i.e. the body text comes down with the record.

name: NITI Aayog - annual reports
description: Annual report series as structured nodes: uuid, attributes.title (year), created/changed dates and the report document link.

name: NITI Aayog - report node collection
description: Separate 'report' content type on the same JSON:API tree: uuid, attributes.title, timestamps and file reference. Small but distinct from reports_and_publication.

name: Nepal BIPAD - disaster loss records
description: The loss record behind each Nepali disaster incident: peopleDeathCount broken out by male/female/other/unknown/disabled, peopleMissing and peopleInjured with the same breakdown, peopleAffectedCount, familyAffected/Relocated/Evacuated, livestockDestroyedCount, infrastructureDestroyed by house/road/bridge/electricity, infrastructureEconomicLoss, agricultureEconomicLoss and estimatedLoss, plus createdOn/modifiedOn.

name: Nepal BIPAD - critical facility register (health, education, security)
description: Named facility register with geometry: title, resourceType (health / education / financial institution / security), GeoJSON point, ward id, dataSource and lastModifiedDate. The detail record adds staffing (noOfEmployee split by sex and disability), phoneNumber, emailAddress, website, localAddress, opening hours and accessibility flags.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Nepal BIPAD - registered disaster-response organizations

name: Nepal BIPAD - citizen incident reports

name: Nepal BIPAD - relief stock holdings by store

name: Nepal BIPAD - municipal DRRM profiles

name: Nepal BIPAD - national DRR priority activities

name: Nepal BIPAD - municipal vulnerability indicators (2021 census)

name: Nepal BIPAD - community spaces register

name: Nepal BIPAD - daily national disaster bulletin

name: Nepal BIPAD - DRR projects register
