Fields: id, waterlevel_datetime, waterlevel_m/msl, flow_rate, discharge, storage_percent, station_type, situation_level (1-5 flood severity), diff_wl_bank_text, river_gid/river_name plus nested agency, basin and station (tele_station_name EN/TH, coordinates). NOTE the document also carries sibling reference arrays (province 80, basin 24, agency 10) - the records are at waterlevel_data.data.

name: Thailand ThaiWater - Yesterday's Rainfall by Named Station
description: 126 daily station totals. Fields: id, tele_station_id, tele_station_name (EN/TH), rainfall_datetime, rainfall_value, province_code/province_name, coordinates, amphoe_name, tumbon_name, agency_name (e.g. Thai Meteorological Department), warning_zone, basin, sub_basin_id, tele_station_oldcode.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Spatial Layers
description: 77 Myanmar geospatial layers (village points by region, admin boundaries, forest cover). Fields: id, title, abstract, category__gn_description, date, detail_url, distribution_url, owner__username, csw_wkt_geometry bounding polygon, uuid. Detail fetch on id 804 returned the full metadata record (typename, workspace, store, keywords, regions, temporal extent, owner) - verified.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Documents
description: Documents attached to Myanmar datasets (licences, methodology notes). Fields: id, title, abstract, category__gn_description, date, detail_url, owner__username, uuid.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Maps
description: Published Myanmar map compositions (e.g. 'Nay Pyi Taw Villages'). Fields: id, title, abstract, date, detail_url, owner__username, thumbnail_url, uuid.

name: Myanmar MIMU GeoNode - Contributor Profiles
description: 17 contributor accounts behind the Myanmar layers. Fields: id, username, first_name, last_name, organization, position, city, country, email, date_joined, layers_count, maps_count, documents_count, profile_detail_url, activity_stream_url. Turns each layer's owner__username into a named person/organisation - the person-behind-the-record pivot for this GeoNode.

name: Brunei Ministry of Finance and Economy - Notices (tender announcements)
description: Brunei MoFE posting feed, in practice the ministry's tender-notice stream (first record title: 'DAILY COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL OF WASTES FROM WASTE COLLECTION CENTRE IN AYER BERKUNCHI, KAMPONG KASAT FOR A PERIOD OF THREE (03) YEARS'). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, excerpt, author, categories, tags. Detail fetch on id 8161 returned the full single post - verified. Keep per_page=20 so the root record array is unambiguously the densest.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Brunei Department of Economic Planning and Statistics - Releases
description: DEPS release feed (statistical bulletins, census/enumeration notices such as 'Penyenaraian Tempat Kediaman 3-23 Ogos 2026'). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, author, categories.

name: Brunei Prime Minister's Office (Jabatan Perdana Menteri) - Announcements
description: Brunei PMO announcement feed. Same WordPress record shape: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered, content.rendered, author, categories, tags.

name: Cambodia Ministry of Post and Telecommunications - Announcements
description: Khmer-language ministry feed (ministerial meetings, telecom policy, licensing news). Fields: id, date, modified, slug, status, link, title.rendered (Khmer), content.rendered, author, categories with named category objects, plus a yoast_head_json block carrying headline and author name. Keep per_page=20: at small page sizes the embedded schema @graph arrays can rival the record array.

name: Malaysia National Flood Warning Telemetry Stations
description: 1,276 DID telemetry stations. Fields: station_id, station_name, latitude, longitude, district, state, sub_basin, main_basin, station_type, water_level_current plus normal/alert/warning/danger thresholds, water_level_indicator (e.g. ALERT), water_level_trend, rainfall_latest_1hr, rainfall_total_today, rainfall_indicator, station_status, station_code and update timestamps. Named station with both an id-ish and a name-ish key.

name: ASIC — Australian company register (full)
description: Every company ever registered in Australia: Company Name, ACN, Type, Class, Sub Class, Status (REGD/DRGD), Date of Registration, Date of Deregistration, Previous State of Registration, State Registration number, ABN, Current Name and Current Name Start Date. 4.4M rows, and &q=<name> full-text searches it server-side.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian business names register
description: Every registered Australian trading name with BN_NAME, BN_STATUS, BN_REG_DT, BN_CANCEL_DT, BN_STATE_NUM, BN_STATE_OF_REG and — the pivot that matters — BN_ABN linking the trading name to the legal entity behind it.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — banned and disqualified persons
description: Named individuals banned by ASIC: BD_PER_NAME, BD_PER_TYPE (Banned Securities / AFS banning / Credit banning / director disqualification), BD_PER_DOC_NUM, start and end dates of the ban, suburb, state, postcode, country and ASIC's comments.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — banned and disqualified organisations
description: Corporate entities banned by ASIC: BD_ORG_ACN, BD_ORG_NAME, BD_ORG_TYPE, ban start and end dates, an ASIC reference URL and comments. Small register but it names companies, and the ACN pivots straight into the 4.4M-row company register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — registered liquidators
description: Every registered and official liquidator in Australia: LIQ_NAME, LIQ_NUM, OFF_LIQ_NUM, registration start dates, LIQ_STATUS, suspension date, locality/state/postcode and LIQ_FIRM — the insolvency practitioner behind a collapse, tied to their firm.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — registered company auditors
description: Registered auditors and audit firms: REG_AUD_NAME, REG_AUD_NUM, REG_AUD_ACN, registration date, status, suspension date and address. The ACN links an audit firm to its own company record.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian Financial Services licensees
description: AFS licence holders: AFS_LIC_NUM, AFS_LIC_NAME, AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN, licence start date, pre-FSR authorisations, address, and the full AFS_LIC_CONDITION text spelling out exactly what financial products the licensee may deal in and advise on.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — AFS authorised representatives
description: 363k authorised representatives sitting under AFS licensees: AFS_REP_NAME, AFS_REP_NUM, the AFS_LIC_NUM they act for, AFS_REP_ABN/ACN, appointment and cessation dates, status, address, cross-endorsement flag and per-authorisation columns. This is the person-behind-the-licensee layer.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Australian credit licensees
description: Credit licence holders: CRED_LIC_NUM, CRED_LIC_NAME, CRED_LIC_ABN_ACN, linked AFSL number, status and status history, locality/state/postcode with latitude and longitude, external dispute resolution scheme, registered business names and the full authorisations text.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — credit representatives
description: Credit representatives and the licensee that appointed them: CRED_REP_NAME, CRED_REP_NUM, CRED_LIC_NUM, ABN/ACN, appointment and end dates, locality/state/postcode, EDR scheme and authorisations. Pairs with the credit-licensee register to build the appointment chain.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — Financial Advisers Register
description: Every financial adviser on ASIC's register: ADV_NAME, ADV_NUMBER, ADV_ROLE and sub-type, role status, adviser ABN, year first provided advice, LICENCE_NAME / LICENCE_NUMBER / LICENCE_ABN and LICENCE_CONTROLLED_BY, start and end dates, overall registration status and CPD failure year.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ASIC — approved SMSF auditors
description: Approved self-managed-super-fund auditors: SMSF_NAME, SMSF_NUM, status, person ABN, registration and suspension dates, locality/state/postcode, the firm they act through (SMSF_CAPACITY_FIRM_NAME) and any ASIC-imposed condition with its full text and condition number.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ACNC — Australian charities register
description: Every registered Australian charity: ABN, Charity_Legal_Name, Other_Organisation_Names, full street address, Charity_Website, Registration_Date, Date_Organisation_Established, Charity_Size, Number_of_Responsible_Persons, financial year end and per-state operating flags.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: ACNC — 2024 Annual Information Statement
description: The financial and activity return each Australian charity files: abn, charity name, registration status, website, size, basic-religious-charity flag, AIS due date, dates the AIS and financial report were received, whether activities were conducted, and a long block of international-activity disclosures (transferring goods or services overseas, operating overseas).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Australian Government historical contract notices
description: Commonwealth contract notices with Agency Name, Parent Contract ID, Contract ID (CN number), Publish/Start/End dates, Value, amendment date and amendment value, Description, Agency Ref ID and UNSPSC code — the award trail behind a federal supplier.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Australian Government Organisations Register
description: Every Commonwealth body: Id (O-xxxxxx), Title, Portfolio, Classification (primary body / subsidiary), Type of Body (non-corporate Commonwealth entity, company, statutory authority), GFS sector classification, materiality and a prose description. Maps the federal entity graph.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission — compliance actions
description: Regulatory actions against NDIS providers: Type (revocation of registration, banning order, compliance notice), Date effective from, Date no longer in force, provider Name including trading name, ABN, city/state/postcode, provider number and the registration groups affected. Names companies and the sanction against them.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: APVMA PUBCRIS — registered agvet chemical products
description: Registered agricultural and veterinary chemical products with pcode, regno and regdate. Thin: only three data columns, so the emitted label is the row number rather than a product name — useful as a registration-number index, not as a browsable list.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IP Australia IPGOD — IP right records
description: Australian intellectual-property rights: ip_right_type and sub_type (pbr, patent, trade mark), application_number, status, earliest filed date, priority date, date registration and enforceable status were gained, enforceable-from and deemed-retired dates.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: AusTender — OCDS contract releases (published)
description: Full Open Contracting releases for Commonwealth contracts published in a date window. Each release carries a parties[] array naming the supplier with its AU-ABN additionalIdentifier and address, plus the buyer, tender, award and contract blocks. Keyless, and the date range is the pagination handle.

name: AusTender — OCDS contract amendments (last modified)
description: The same OCDS release structure filtered on last-modified date, which surfaces contract AMENDMENTS — value variations and extensions that never appear in the original publication feed. Same parties[]/ABN payload. Other valid dateTypes on this endpoint are contractStart and contractEnd.

name: Victorian Building Authority — building practitioner register
description: Registered Victorian building practitioners: Account Name, Type (Person / Company), Accreditation ID, Accreditation Status, ABN, ACN, Limitation (e.g. Commercial Builder - Limited) and commenced/expires dates. The ABN and ACN pivot into the ASIC company register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — environmental enforcement actions register
description: Queensland environmental enforcement orders naming the recipient: Enforcement Reference, Enforcement Type (Environmental Enforcement Order, Transitional Environmental Program), Issued To (person or company), CC To, Issued Date, Status, Activities, Locations (lot/plan), related environmental authority, evaluator name and subsequent action.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — environmental authorities (permit holders)
description: Queensland environmental permits: Permit Reference, Permit Type, Permit Holder(s) (named company), Effective Date, Status (Granted/Surrendered), Condition Type, Industry, the specific Environmentally Relevant Activities authorised and locations. Facility-level regulatory footprint behind a corporate name.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland Government contracts directory — awarded contracts
description: Awarded Queensland state contracts: Agency Name and Agency Address, contract Description, Date, Value, Supplier Name and Supplier Address. Supplier addresses at street level make this unusually good for entity resolution.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland Health — grant funding recipients
description: Organisations funded by Queensland Health: Organisation Name, Project Title, description of the funded services, Contract End Date and the funding amount per financial year. Follows public money to named non-government providers.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — supplier procurement arrangements directory
description: Standing offer arrangements: ID ref, Arrangement Number, Arrangement Name, State (Published), Categories / Subcategories / Product and Service Groups, Start and Expiry dates, Status and access permission. The panel structure suppliers sit inside.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — registered water service providers
description: Registered drinking-water and sewerage service providers: Name (literal field), SPID, and boolean flags for drinking water provider, water service and sewerage service. Small register but the label field is an exact 'Name'.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Queensland — resource authority holder name changes
description: Mining and petroleum permit holder renames: Permit Number, Permit Type, Activity ID, Authorised Holder, Completion Date, LGA, and Notes spelling out the old and new corporate names verbatim. Tiny but it is a direct corporate-rename ledger for resource tenements.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — officers register
description: 583k charity officers with FirstName/MiddleName/LastName/FullName, ContactId, OrganisationId, PositioninOrganisation (Chair, Trustee), appointment and last-day dates, OfficerStatus, and a full disqualification block: BannedDirector, IsNotDisqualified, OfficerProhibitedFromBeingDirector, OfficerUndischargedBankrupt, OfficerBeenConvicted, ConvictedOfAnOffenseRelatingToTerrorism, SubjectToBanningOrder, DisqualifiedByBoard, OfficerSubjectToPropertyOrder.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — officer-to-organisation join view
description: The officer record joined to its charity in one row: FullName, OfficerId, ContactId, position, appointment date and disqualification flags PLUS the organisation's Name, CharityRegistrationNumber, NZBNNumber, CharitySummaryURL, WebSiteURL, email and telephone. One request gives you person and entity together — and the NZBN pivots into the NZ business register.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — registered charities (extended view)
description: 45,930 registered NZ charities with a literal Name field, OrganisationId, AccountId GUID, CharityRegistrationNumber (CCxxxxx), NZBNNumber, CharitySummaryURL, WebSiteURL, email and phone. Distinct from the base Organisations set: this view carries the NZBN and contact columns.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: NZ Charities Services — annual financial returns
description: 421k charity annual returns with roughly 90 financial columns per row: OrganisationId, GroupId, AsAtDate, YearEnded, Status, all current and non-current liabilities, cash and bank balances, investments, land and buildings, GovtGrantsContracts, GrantsPaidWithinNZ and GrantsPaidOutsideNZ, SalariesAndWages, employee counts and volunteer hours. NOTE: no name field — the label is AnnualReturnId, or the AsAtDate + numeric fallback.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — voting results database
description: 541,840 individual division records from the Legislative Council: id, start_date, committee type, term_no, vote_number, vote_date, vote_time, the motion text in Chinese and English, and the member-level vote. Shows exactly how each HK legislator voted on each motion.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — bills database
description: Every bill put before LegCo: internal_key, ordinance_title_eng and _chi, bill_title_eng and _chi, and ordinance_content_url_eng/_chi linking straight to the consolidated text on elegislation.gov.hk. The legislative history behind any HK ordinance.

name: Hong Kong LegCo — Hansard speeches
description: 550,841 individual speeches from the LegCo record: RundownID, HansardID, MeetingDate, HansardType (English/Chinese), SectionID and SectionName, SpeakerID, SpeakerName and the full Speeches text. Every attributable utterance by a named HK legislator or official since 2001.

name: Hong Kong Companies Registry — newly registered local companies (weekly)
description: The Companies Registry's weekly drop of newly incorporated Hong Kong companies: Seq, Current Company Name in English, Current Company Name in Chinese, BR Number (business registration number), Date of Incorporation and Date of Change of name. HK gates almost everything else behind paid document purchase — this is the free incorporation firehose. URL date rotates weekly; the dated file stays served.

name: Hong Kong Companies Registry — newly registered non-Hong Kong companies (weekly)
description: Foreign companies newly registered to carry on business in Hong Kong: Seq, Current Corporate Name / Other Corporate Name, Current Approved Name for Carrying on Business in H.K., BR Number, Date of Registration and Date of Change of name. Each entity appears twice, once in Latin script and once in Chinese, sharing a Seq — the cross-script alias pair is itself the intel.

name: Hong Kong Security and Guarding Services Industry Authority — licensed security companies
description: Every licensed HK security company: Company name (English), other name the company may trade as, Type(s) of security work, Licence Number, full street Address and Telephone Number. Address and phone make this directly useful for entity resolution against the Companies Registry.

name: Korea MOLEG — English-titled statute search
description: Korean statutes with both Korean and ENGLISH names: id, 법령ID, 법령일련번호 (MST), 법령명한글, 법령명영문 (e.g. FAIR TRANSACTIONS IN FRANCHISE BUSINESS ACT), 법령구분명, 소관부처명 (competent ministry), 공포번호, 공포일자, 시행일자 and a detail link. Keyless — OC=test is the documented public demo id and it works.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — Supreme Court and lower court precedent search
description: Korean court judgments matching a query: id, 사건번호 (case number, e.g. 대법원-2025-두-34754), 사건명 (case name, which names the parties), 선고일자, 법원명, 사건종류명, 판례일련번호 and 판례상세링크. The detail service returns 판시사항, 판결요지 and the full reasoning. This is Korea's case-law layer, keyless.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — municipal ordinance and rule search
description: Local-government ordinances: id, 자치법규ID, 자치법규명, 자치법규일련번호, 지자체기관명 (the specific city/gu that enacted it, e.g. 서울특별시 송파구), 자치법규종류, 시행일자 and detail link. Ties regulatory action to a named Korean local authority.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea Constitutional Court — decision search
description: Constitutional Court rulings: id, 사건번호 (e.g. 2002헌가20), 종국일자, 사건명 naming the statute under challenge, 헌재결정례일련번호 and detail link. The detail service returns the reviewed provision text and the full reasoning.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea MOLEG — official statutory interpretations
description: Binding legal interpretations issued by the Ministry of Government Legislation: id, 안건명 (the question asked), 안건번호, 회신기관명 and code (who answered), 질의기관명 and code (which agency asked), 회신일자 and 법령해석례일련번호. The detail service returns the full 이유 reasoning. Shows which agency was uncertain about which rule.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — administrative appeal (행정심판) rulings
description: Rulings on administrative appeals against government decisions: id, 재결청 (adjudicating body, e.g. 국민권익위원회), 처분청 (the agency whose decision was challenged), 사건번호, 사건명 describing the contested disposition, 의결일자, 처분일자 and 행정심판재결례일련번호. The detail service returns 청구취지 and full reasoning. Citizen-vs-agency disputes that never reach a court.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Korea — treaty register search
description: Treaties Korea is party to: id, 조약명 (naming the counterparty state), 서명일자, 조약번호, 조약구분코드 (bilateral/multilateral) and 관보게제일자 (official gazette publication date). Bilateral instruments behind Korean trade and investment relationships.

name: Taiwan GCIS — company financial and control record by unified business number
description: The by-UBN detail record the tree's name-search row is missing: Business_Accounting_NO, Company_Name, Company_Status_Desc, Capital_Stock_Amount, Paid_In_Capital_Amount, Share_Val, Equity_Amt, Responsible_Name (the legal representative), Company_Location, Register_Organization_Desc (the registering authority), Company_Setup_Date, Change_Of_Approval_Data, Revoke_App_Date and suspension dates. Paid-in capital and the responsible person are the two fields the name-search endpoint does not return.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Taiwan GCIS — company record with licensed business scope
description: Company record plus the nested Cmp_Business array: every licensed business item the company may legally conduct, with Business_Seq_NO, Business_Item (the MOEA code, e.g. CC01080) and Business_Item_Desc. TSMC alone returns 17 items. Reveals what a Taiwanese entity is actually permitted to do, which often contradicts its stated line of business.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Taiwan GCIS — unified business number to company name resolver
description: Minimal two-field lookup returning Business_Accounting_NO and Company_Name. Cheap canonical-name resolution for a Taiwanese UBN harvested from an invoice, tender award or shipping manifest, before spending a request on the fuller registry endpoints.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: Pacific Data Hub Microdata Library — survey and census catalogue
description: 693 microdata collections across the Pacific Islands from SPC's NADA catalogue: id, idno (e.g. SPC_ASM_2025_PHC_v01_M), title, nation (American Samoa, Fiji, PNG, Samoa, Vanuatu, Solomon Islands, Tonga...), authoring_entity (the national statistics office that ran it), year_start/year_end, type (survey/census), repositoryid and repo_title. The detail hop returns full study metadata including variable count. Fills the Pacific-island gap where no company registry API exists.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — field reports (operational situation reports)
description: Per-emergency field report: title, casualty/affected counts (num_dead, num_injured, num_missing, num_displaced, gov_ and other_ variants), epidemic case counts, DREF/appeal amounts requested, ERU deployment flags by unit type, national-society contacts, countries/districts, actions taken. The detail hop with a real id (18533) returns the same record plus full contact and action narrative.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — 3W national-society projects
description: Who-does-what-where: project name, reporting national society, beneficiary country and districts, sector, programme/operation type, budget_amount, actual_expenditure, target vs reached beneficiaries split by sex, start/end dates. Detail hop verified with id 2510.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — surge personnel deployments
description: Individual surge deployments: delegate name (often null in the public feed, which is why the label falls to id), role, deployment type (FACT/RDRT/ERU), country_from and country_to with national society, start/end dates, molnix roster id. Names people to operations — a rare personnel-level humanitarian record.

name: IFRC GO — appeal documents
description: Every DREF/emergency-appeal document with its download URL, document type, appeal code (MDRxxNNN), the parent appeal object with its event and start date, and country ISO. The document_url is a direct file link into go-api.ifrc.org.

name: IFRC GO — national societies directory
description: 281 countries/territories with the Red Cross/Red Crescent national society name, society URL, IFRC directory URL, FDRS code, postal address, phone, emails, website, INFORM risk score, bbox and centroid. Detail hop (id 14) adds contacts and NSI income/expenditure/branch counts.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFRC GO — subnational districts gazetteer
description: Admin-1 gazetteer used to geocode every IFRC field report and project: district name, code, parent country name/ISO/ISO3, NUTS1/2/3 codes, FIPS code, EMMA id, World Bank population and year, bbox and centroid.

name: IFRC GO — regional focal points
description: Named IFRC regional focal points with personal name, email address and the geographic extent they cover. Small but it is real named-individual contact data.

name: UN OCHA FTS — humanitarian funding flows 2026
description: Donor-to-recipient money movements: amountUSD, original amount and currency, exchange rate, contribution type, flow type, earmarking, decision/first-reported dates, sourceObjects and destinationObjects (naming the donor organisation, the receiving agency, the plan, the cluster and the location), parent/child flow ids and reportDetails. Note the array is data.flows — the auto-detector would pick a metadata array instead.

name: UN OCHA FTS — location registry
description: 258 countries/territories with FTS internal id, ISO3, pcode, admin level and isRegion flag — the join key that turns an FTS flow's destination id into a country.

name: WHO — collaborating centres directory
description: Designated WHO Collaborating Centres worldwide: reference code (e.g. KOR-106), TitleOfTheCentre (the actual institution), host website, date of designation, last redesignation, expiry date, WHOCC portal URL. Institution-level records tying named research bodies to WHO. Detail hop verified with a real GUID.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: WHO — emergencies register
description: WHO-graded emergencies: title (e.g. Ebola outbreak North Kivu/Ituri DRC), start and end dates, emergency rating, overview and summary HTML, canonical URL slug.

name: WHO — emergency events
description: Event taxonomy behind the outbreak news — event title (Cholera, Mpox…), EventId, event start date. This is the key that joins WHO Disease Outbreak News items to a named event.

name: WHO — member state register
description: Country records with official name, colloquial synonyms, ISO numeric, two-letter code, WHO code, member-state flag, WHO relationship type and country overview text.

name: WHO — governing-body documents
description: WHO document register: document title, publication year, alternate/canonical URL to the PDF, publication date, provider.

name: WHO — programme activities
description: Named WHO programme activities with title, summary, impact statistics, publication datetime and canonical URL — what WHO is actually running, country by country.

name: WHO — official biographies
description: Biography records for WHO officials and directors: title, biography HTML, summary, parent record id linking the person to their unit. Named-person data inside a UN agency.

name: WHO — publications catalogue
description: Publication records with title, editors, ISBN, page count, download links, overview and highlights — including weekly surveillance bulletins (dracunculiasis, meningitis) that carry live case counts.

name: WHO — meeting reports
description: Reports of WHO expert meetings and weekly epidemiological bulletins: title, subtitle, ISBN, overview, publication datetime, related-item counts.

name: WHO — Director-General and senior speeches
description: Full speech records: title, occasion, Location (where it was delivered), publication datetime, speech duration and the complete Content body.

name: WHO — partner organizations
description: Organizations WHO names as partners/donors (first record: Global Environment Facility) with organization title and WebsiteURL — an org-to-org relationship list.

name: WHO — policy indicator register
description: Named policy/regulatory indicators (e.g. alcohol advertising restrictions on social media) with footnote, WHO priority level, IMR definition id and parent grouping.

name: WHO — health topics
description: WHO health-topic records (including Biological weapons) with summary, three tabbed sections of body text, technical links and canonical URL.

name: WHO — departments
description: WHO internal departments (R&D Blueprint etc.) with title, external page URL and canonical slug — the org chart backing the biographies and programmes feeds.

name: WHO — programmes
description: Named WHO programmes with title, publication date and canonical URL.

name: WHO — SDG goal records
description: WHO's own SDG entries: goal title, goal number, description, summary, external link and colour code.

name: WHO — normative recommendations
description: WHO guideline recommendations (e.g. insecticide-treated nets) with the full recommendation Body and the IRIS document id (IRISID) that links to the source guideline.

name: WHO — country profiles
description: Per-country thematic profiles (e.g. Oral Health Egypt 2022) with report start and end dates and canonical URL.

name: WHO — news items
description: WHO newsroom items with title, news type, provider, publication datetime and canonical URL. Distinct collection from the diseaseoutbreaknews feed already in the tree.

name: UN Statistics — SDG goals
description: The 17 SDG goals with code, title, description and API uri. Detail hop verified with code 1 — returns that goal's targets, so this is the entry point to the whole SDG tree.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UN Statistics — SDG targets
description: All 169 SDG targets with goal, code (1.1), full target text, description and the nested indicator list belonging to each target.

name: UN Statistics — SDG indicators
description: 251 official SDG indicators: goal, target, indicator code, full description, tier classification and the nested series that measure it. Detail hop verified with code 1.1.1 — returns every data series under that indicator.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UN Statistics — SDG data series
description: 713 SDG data series with series code (DC_ODA_BDVDL), the goals/targets/indicators each maps to, release version and full description — the code list you need to query Series/Data.

name: UN Statistics — SDG geo areas
description: 460 UN M49 geographic areas (countries, regions, aggregates) with geoAreaCode and geoAreaName — the join key for every SDG observation.

name: UN Statistics — SDG observations (extreme poverty series)
description: Actual SDG observations: geoAreaCode/geoAreaName, time period, value, upper and lower bound, base period, the named source institution, footnotes and the full attribute/dimension breakdown. 11,407 rows for this one series; swap seriesCode for any of the 713. Array is at data — the response also carries attributes and dimensions arrays that would fool the auto-detector.

name: UNHCR — refugee population by origin and asylum country
description: Origin-country x asylum-country pairs with refugees, asylum_seekers, returned_refugees, IDPs, returned_idps, stateless, others of concern and host-community counts. coo_all/coa_all are REQUIRED — without them every row collapses to '-' and the parser drops the lot.

name: UNHCR — asylum decisions
description: Asylum decision outcomes per origin/asylum pair: recognised, other outcome, rejected, closed, total, plus procedure type, decision level and protection category. 2.16 million decisions in 2024 alone.

name: UNHCR — asylum applications
description: New asylum applications lodged, by origin and asylum country, with procedure type, application type, decision level and protection category.

name: UNHCR — durable solutions
description: Returned refugees, resettlement departures, naturalisations and returned IDPs by origin and asylum country — who actually left the caseload and how.

name: UNHCR — demographics of displaced populations
description: Age/sex disaggregation of displaced populations by asylum country: female and male counts in bands 0-4, 5-11, 12-17, 18-59, 60+, other and totals.

name: UNHCR — UNRWA registered Palestine refugees
description: UNRWA-registered Palestine refugee totals by field of operation (State of Palestine, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria).

name: World Bank — debarred and cross-debarred firms and individuals
description: THE World Bank sanctions list, 1,530 entries: SUPP_NAME (firm or named individual), SUPP_ID, entity type (I=individual/F=firm), full street address, city, country, ineligibility from/to dates, the grounds for debarment and cross-debarment status under the MDB agreement. The label lands on COUNTRY_NAME because country_name outranks the _NAME suffix fallback in the parser; SUPP_NAME is still in every record's props. Key is published in clear in the public debarred-firms page source, not private.

name: World Bank — IBRD statement of loans and guarantees
description: 9,513 IBRD loans: loan_number, country, named borrower entity (e.g. MINISTRY OF FINANCE), guarantor, loan type and status, interest rate, project_id and project_name, original principal, cancelled, undisbursed, disbursed, repaid, due, borrower's obligation, first/last repayment dates, agreement signing and board approval dates. 10.4 MB. Labels on region because region precedes country in the title precedence — country, borrower and project_name are all in props.

name: World Bank — microdata survey catalogue
description: Survey and census catalogue across the World Bank, UNHCR, IHSN and national statistics offices: title, idno, DOI, survey type, country, authoring entity, collection years, form model, repository. Detail hop verified with idno AFG_2024_CBPM-Q3_v01_M (note: it takes the idno string, NOT the numeric id — the numeric id returns IDNO-NOT-FOUND).  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: IFC — investment project disclosures
description: Newly disclosed IFC investment projects with CompanyName (the actual private counterparty, e.g. JUMIA TECHNOLOGIES AG), ProjectNumber, ProjectName, country, region, industry, environmental category, status, disclosed date, project overview, the eight IFC Performance Standard flags and MultiLatitude/MultiLongitude. Small window (5) but it is the private-sector-counterparty surface of the World Bank Group, refreshed as projects disclose.

name: UNDP — transparency portal projects
description: UNDP project register: project_id, title, description, budget and expense in USD, country, sector list with codes, SDG mappings, signature solution, donor list and gender/policy markers. The year parameter is mandatory — without it the API returns 400.

name: Green Climate Fund — approved projects
description: All 372 GCF projects: ProjectName, approved reference (FP001), board meeting, theme, sector, lifetime CO2, risk category, direct and indirect beneficiaries, total GCF funding, co-financing, total value, project URL, plus nested Countries, accredited Entities, Disbursements, Funding tranches and ResultAreas. Detail hop verified with ProjectsID 13020.  A per-record detail endpoint was verified for this source; see the batch's detail-hops side-car. This collector fetches the list endpoint only.

name: UNESCO UIS — geographic units
description: 462 UIS geographic units with ISO3 id, name and type (NATIONAL/REGIONAL) — the geography codelist for UNESCO education statistics. The sibling indicators endpoint is already in the tree; the actual data endpoint is NOT returned because its records carry no name-ish or id-ish field.

name: UNICEF — SDMX dataflow catalogue
description: 42 UNICEF statistical dataflows (CAUSE_OF_DEATH, immunisation, child protection…) with id, human name, multilingual names, version, agency and the URN of the data structure behind each — the map of what UNICEF publishes and how to query it.

name: ILOSTAT — SDG 1.1.1 working poverty series
description: ILO's keyless plumber API: ref_area (ISO3), named source series, indicator code, sex, age classification, time and obs_value with observation status. 2,088 observations for this one indicator from 2023; the id parameter swaps in any ILOSTAT indicator code (an unfiltered pull of EMP_TEMP_SEX_AGE_NB_A returned 54 MB, so keep timefrom set).

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — aid activities
description: 425,402 IATI activities published by every bilateral and multilateral donor — iati_identifier, title narratives, reporting org, participating orgs with role, recipient countries, sectors, budgets, planned disbursements and transactions. This is the keyless mirror of the IATI Datastore (api.iatistandard.org requires a subscription key). The q and fl parameters are BOTH required: without q the docs array is empty, and without fl=id the records carry only multi-valued arrays and every one is dropped for want of a scalar label.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — aid transactions
description: Individual aid transactions under each activity: transaction_ref, type (commitment/disbursement/expenditure), date, value in original currency and USD, provider and receiver organisation refs and narratives, recipient country and sector. Money-level granularity beneath the activity. Same fl=id requirement as the activity endpoint.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — publishing organisations
description: Organisation files: organisation-identifier (US-GOV-1), name narratives, reporting org ref and type, total budget with period and budget lines, recipient-country and recipient-region budgets, total expenditure with expense lines, and document links. The org-level financial statement behind every IATI publisher.

name: IATI Datastore (iati.cloud) — activity results and indicators
description: Results framework attached to aid activities: result title and description, indicator measure and title, baseline, period start/end, target and actual values with location refs and comments, plus the parent activity's iati-identifier, reporting org and dataset provenance. Note the label value is the result type code ('1'), so titles are weak — result_title and the indicator narrative are in props.

name: African Development Bank — MapAfrica results indicators
description: The 35 AfDB results indicators (people with access to better health services, etc.) with slug id and full name — the codelist behind the MapAfrica project portal. The project/activity endpoint on the same host needs a real AfDB activity id and Cloudflare began challenging before I could verify one, so only this verified endpoint is returned.
